subject: RFQ - Measurement System Upgrade
rfq_text:
Dear Sales Team,

Customer: Vertex Measurement Technologies AG
RFQ Reference: RFQ731-000001
Customer Reference: Measurement System Upgrade
Country: Germany

Please provide a suitable measurement system for utility water measurement.

We would like to request a quotation for the following measurement solution:

The application requires gas measurement.
The required device configuration is general-purpose configuration.
The unit should support alternative power supply.
We require number of measurement channels 1.
The measurement point requires explosion protection A.
The system should include protection area 2.
The required certification is MN.
The required communication interface is data interface NN.
The system should provide current input IS1.
Temperature measurement capability is required (TT1).
The system should include WaveInjector cryogenic option.
The system should include Advanced Meter Verification 1.
The system should include Dynamic Gas Master 1.
The system should include custom user fluid 1.
If possible, please include stainless-steel housing.
If possible, please include switchable current output CS1.
If possible, please include digital open-collector input MN1.

Please provide your best commercial offer including delivery lead time.

Please let us know if additional technical information is required.

Best regards,
Anna Schneider
Vertex Measurement Technologies AG
